description: This file defines the EmptyNode class within the Twig templating engine. It represents an empty node object used in the Twig syntax tree, with behavior preventing any child nodes from being added.

classes.name: EmptyNode
classes.description: A final class representing an empty node in Twig's syntax tree. It extends Node and prohibits adding child nodes. It also has a constructor setting line number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an EmptyNode instance, calling parent constructor with empty children and line number.

methods.name: setNode
methods.description: Prevents adding child nodes by throwing a LogicException if called.
